core_obligations: The author combines the constructive Euclidean Schreiber argument with the Heisenberg commutator formula. Control of symplectic commutators forces coarse central density in the nonabelian case and yields a connected subgroup around which the approximate subgroup is relatively dense, together with the original conditional discreteness of its horizontal projection.
